from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)

# red shoe mask: R high relative to G,B
red = (R>55)&(R-G>25)&(R-B>25)
ys,xs = np.where(red)

# left region x<100
m = red & (np.indices(R.shape)[1]<100)
ys,xs=np.where(m); print('left red bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max(), 'count',m.sum())
m = red & (np.indices(R.shape)[1]>200)
ys,xs=np.where(m); print('right red bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max(),'count',m.sum())
# dark arm mask (very dark)
dark=(R<45)&(G<50)&(B<45)
m=dark & (np.indices(R.shape)[1]<60) & (np.indices(R.shape)[0]<160)
ys,xs=np.where(m); print('arm dark bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max(),'count',m.sum())
# white sole: bright low saturation
bright=(R>150)&(G>140)&(B>110)
ys,xs=np.where(bright & (np.indices(R.shape)[1]<100)); print('left bright bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max())
ys,xs=np.where(bright & (np.indices(R.shape)[1]>200)); print('right bright bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max())
